question: Which global institutions influenced India’s 1991 economic reforms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank & IMF**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The economic reforms of 1991 in India were significantly influenced by international financial institutions like the **World Bank** and the **International Monetary Fund (IMF)**.
 
• India faced a severe balance of payments crisis in 1991, and financial assistance from the World Bank and IMF came with conditions to liberalize the economy.
